characters.identity_anchors: Lean pale adult man, hollow dark eyes, disheveled dark hair, sharp hearing posture, intense fixed gaze; never named in source
characters.source_evidence: Book opening and throughout first-person: nervous acute senses especially hearing; screenplay Notes lock lean pale hollow dark eyes disheveled dark hair shirtsleeves dark waistcoat; no given name in Poe
characters.voice_label: tense intimate confessional baritone, quickening under strain

wardrobe_variants.description: Shirtsleeves under dark waistcoat, no coat, disheveled; sometimes holding or near closed dark lantern
source_facts: works at midnight with dark lantern
present in chamber day and night
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: period 1840s plain linen shirt slightly open at collar, charcoal wool waistcoat unbuttoned under stress later, dark trousers, soft shoes for stealth; lantern as signature prop in night scenes

wardrobe_variants.description: Same shirtsleeves and dark waistcoat, hearty upright bearing for morning visit
source_facts: went boldly into the chamber morning
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: same base wardrobe as night but posture open and smiling; no lantern

wardrobe_variants.description: Same shirtsleeves dark waistcoat, light-hearted composed smile at door
source_facts: went down to open street door with a light heart
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: identical base look; calm welcoming demeanor until later chamber breakdown

characters.identity_anchors: Frail elderly man, thin white hair, one pale blue eye with a film (vulture eye); otherwise ordinary beloved housemate
characters.source_evidence: Book: 'He had the eye of a vulture—a pale blue eye, with a film over it'; loved by narrator; sleeps in chamber bed; shrieks once when attacked
characters.voice_label: thin aged, weak murmur by day; single sharp shriek; stifled terror groan

wardrobe_variants.description: Nightshirt or simple sleeping clothes in high bed; filmed pale blue eye closed, half-lidded, or wide open per beat
source_facts: eye closed seven nights then open wide eighth night
frail enough to be dragged and covered by heavy bed
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: plain off-white period nightshirt, thin white hair loose on pillow; keep the filmed blue eye as the only distinctive facial feature; corpse state after S6 with no blood visible on bedding per tub catch

characters.identity_anchors: Adult man, bearded, calm bearing; one of three police officers in plain dark period coats
characters.source_evidence: Book: three men introduced themselves with perfect suavity as officers of the police; screenplay assigns bearded calm to Reynolds; speaks the search premise line

wardrobe_variants.description: Plain dark period coat, bearded, calm expression
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: 1840s dark wool frock coat, simple waistcoat and cravat, no ornate badge required; beard neatly kept; remains composed through confession

characters.identity_anchors: Younger adult man, watchful; one of three police officers in plain dark period coats
characters.source_evidence: Book: three officers search and sit chatting of familiar things; screenplay assigns younger watchful to Hale
characters.voice_label: lighter younger official tone, mostly ambient chat

wardrobe_variants.description: Plain dark period coat, younger clean-shaven or light stubble, watchful eyes
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: matching dark frock coat to other officers; slightly less formal posture; watches narrator as tension rises but keeps pleasant smile

characters.identity_anchors: Tall adult man, soft-spoken manner; one of three police officers in plain dark period coats
characters.source_evidence: Book: three officers; screenplay assigns tall soft-spoken to Clemm

wardrobe_variants.description: Plain dark period coat, tall build, mild expression
source_facts: sat and chatted pleasantly and smiled
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: same dark frock coat family; height contrast to Hale; remains seated smiling during narrator's breakdown

locations.source_evidence: Book: the old man's chamber/bedroom with bed, door latch, shutters close fastened through fear of robbers, flooring planks and scantlings, dark lantern ray, death watches in the wall, chairs brought in, treasures secure; narrator sits upon spot above corpse
layout_anchors: door with latch opening from hall/entry side
wooden floorboards with three liftable planks over scantlings
space for chairs near center/over burial spot
lighting_states: NIGHT candlelight and single thin lantern ray in deep shadow pitch black when shutters closed
DAY morning light seeping through closed shutters
persistent_props: tub (for blood catch, present during concealment)
locations.image_brief: Tight gothic bedroom interior, bare or sparse 1840s furnishings, heavy shadows, wooden floor with hidden cavity under three planks, high bed, shuttered window, door with quiet latch; candle and lantern as primary night sources

locations.source_evidence: Book: knocking at the street door; narrator went down to open it; three officers entered; leads them over the house then to chamber
layout_anchors: immediate interior entry/hall space leading toward chamber
lighting_states: NIGHT dark exterior spill and dim interior when door opens still dark as midnight four o'clock
locations.image_brief: Narrow period entry or front hall at street door, dark early-morning interior, door opening onto three officers; simple wood and plaster, no modern fixtures
